0022600152.text: The Spurs, now 2-2 and riding a two-game winning streak, host the Timberwolves (3-1, on a one-game losing streak) in the sixth game of San Antonio's season, with the Spurs 3rd in the Southwest and 7th in the West while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while in 2025-26 the Spurs lost 1-2 in the regular season and won 4-2 in the playoffs, including a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery).
